why: native HD: which iPhones get the full-detail world
new:
## An iPhone with the memory for the full-detail world: 6 GB and up (iPhone 12 Pro and later Pros,
## iPhone 15 and later). It gets the HD graphics tier, full-resolution voxel buildings and trees,
## and the 3D drawn at Full HD instead of the phone's half resolution. Smaller phones keep the
## light world, which is what fits their memory.
static func native_hd() -> bool:
	if not native():
		return false
	var force: = OS.get_environment("CHIK_NATIVE_HD")
	if force != "":
		return force == "1"
	return int(OS.get_memory_info().get("physical", 0)) >= 5_500_000_000
